messages:
dylan_sales: Spruce Inc wants a 2-week POC in their AWS account. They sent a checklist: which do we recommend (PrivateLink vs peering), do we need a bastion for installer, minimal firewall, and how to show endpoint costs in the SOW?

morgan_neteng: Short answer: PrivateLink for single-account, cross-account isolation, and when you want to avoid route table changes. Peering if they have multiple VPCs in same account/region and need bare-metal-like latency.

dylan_sales: They asked about DNS resolution for PrivateLink endpointswill their internal names resolve automatically?

morgan_neteng: If they enable private DNS on the endpoint, our service domain (e.g., api.redwood.internal) will resolve to the endpoint ENIs. Otherwise they must add conditional forwarders or Route53 Resolver rules for peering.

asha_security: Security items to return in the questionnaire: no inbound public traffic to service subnets, enable VPC Flow Logs (ship to S3 or Kinesis), restrict endpoint policy to their account(s), and require TLS for control plane.

ben_deploy: Installer note: we support unattended HTTPS installer so a permanent bastion isn't required. Best practice: enable SSM Session Manager and grant our installer role access for ephemeral troubleshooting. If SSM is disallowed, request a time-limited bastion with tight SG rules.

morgan_neteng: Minimal firewall snippet to send to customer's network team: 
- Allow outbound TCP 443 to: 34.198.12.0/24, 52.23.89.0/24 (redwood control-plane)
- If using PrivateLink: allow traffic to ENI IPs created by the interface endpoint (AWS manages these)
- For peering: add route table entries for our service subnet and allow intra-VPC traffic on required ports
- Avoid opening 22; prefer SSM

billing_ae: For SOW pricing: include one-time onboarding, hourly PrivateLink endpoint charge (AWS regional rate), per-GB data processing on endpoint, and our POC support hours. Example line: "AWS Interface Endpoint: ~$0.01/hr (region dep.), Data processing: ~$0.01/GB" (call out as estimate).

dylan_sales: Any operational gotchas we should call out?

morgan_neteng: Proxy/TLS-inspect is common. If they terminate and inspect TLS, call out SNI passthrough requirement or use PrivateLink with end-to-end TLS so intercepted traffic doesn't break auth. Also note peering can't cross-region.

asha_security: Ask them: retention period for logs, whether they need KMS/HSM integration for keys, and which teams can access the endpoint (list of principal ARNs). We'll include that in the questionnaire response.

deploybot: Quickstart template: templates/privatedeploy/aws/poc_quickstart.yaml. Run `./deploy.sh --account <acct> --region <region>` after cross-account role is provisioned.

ben_deploy: Action items for sales handoff: 1) collect AWS account ID(s) and VPC CIDRs, 2) confirm preferred topology (PrivateLink vs peering), 3) confirm SSM allowed or request bastion window, 4) security contact for endpoint policy + log retention, 5) region for cost estimate.

dylan_sales: I'll request those and paste their answers here. Sending the firewall snippet and a short cost estimate to the AE now. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
